items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: And after that I went with Sidney Desvien. ... I went with Desvien around 30 ... And then I went with Sidney. ... Oh, until the first part of 34.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was on the one up here on the Crozat Street or Franklin Street they used to call it. Yes. I remember the building but I never did get in there before then.
And after that I went with Sidney Desvien. Oh yes.
I played with them. Went on the boat with them.
